model_selection: frozen C visible_context seed0; no P1 fitting, selection or calibration
primary_metrics: V/C per-factor accuracy, balanced accuracy, macro-F1, NLL and zero support; source/actor/cutoff separated
secondary_metrics: F/A/B/Q only under supplied state_loss_mask; rule/retrospective annotation agreement, not mental truth
state_mask: state_loss_mask[f] == 1; UNKNOWN never supervised; no label restoration from state_withdrawn
disabled_reason: P1 turn/frame/episode-tail windows are not calibrated P0 decision opportunities; no verified pending-step/graph mapping

adapter_policy.steps: 1..8 only; never truncate or create dummy steps
adapter_policy.background_facts: world only; source access may refer to user rather than modeled assistant
adapter_policy.external_event_access: UNCERTAIN; no receipt/comprehension inferred from observer annotation
adapter_policy.comprehension: unknown for external events; no text parser or UNDERSTOOD fabrication
adapter_policy.completion: reject unsupported own-goal completion; never reinterpret as completion by another actor
adapter_policy.progress: own phase entry -> step_started; no earlier steps marked complete
adapter_policy.text: not encoded by this model; no keyword/label heuristic
